name: Dagger
lore: To cut a slice of bread, a strip of meat or the throat of your opponent.

name: Broad Dagger
lore: A broad dagger made less for cutting bread and more for dark alleys and facing ill armoured foes.

name: Parrying Dagger
lore: A light and quick parrying blade, meant to be wielded together with a main weapon for a good defensive option.

name: Spiked Knuckleduster
lore: "A broken nose is still a nose. A broken honour is no honour at all." ~ Vanir saying

name: Falchion
lore: One cut is all it takes. The Falchion is not a weapon of beauty or grace, more like a butchers cleaver in fact. It does its job. No more, no less.

name: Bone Club
lore: The Rana Guards are armed with these when they start their training. As they advance through their trials, they leave the savage bone clubs behind and opt for more powerful weapons.

name: Handgun Prototype
lore: "I see a future where all Wielders of Barya carry a personal handgun, always at hand for close encounters. Armed with such a fine and ingenious ranged weapon it will inspire the artillery troops to strive harder." ~ Babak Gunsmith

name: Throwing Axe
lore: A well balanced Vanir axe, equally impressive up close and from a distance. A versatile weapon in the right hands.

name: Bone Scimitar
lore: "The frogs find ways to create sharp and nasty weapons even without forges or fire. Theyre not smiths by trade, but cunning by nature." ~ Terhez Weaponsmith, Azure Oasis

name: Ancient Blade
lore: "The shape is unlike any dagger I ever saw. Its still sharp despite the years it spent buried in the ground. It has no magic properties, but it will make a formidable weapon in the right hands." ~ Words of a Baryan merchant, specialized in ancient artifacts

name: Dragon Tooth
lore: Though long since dead, the essence of a dragon still lingers within it.

name: Dagger of Rage
lore: "Feel that? Anyone who comes near the dagger reacts the same way. You get quicker to anger and malice. Carried by a Wielder this dagger can inspire the weakest troops to beat the strongest opponents." ~ Sophia Hadergast, speaking to her young apprentice Mehry

name: Bewitched Blade
lore: It not only cuts through flesh like a hot knife through butter, it also strengthens the effect of destructive spells. Truly a weapon for Wielders and not the common folk.

name: Old Sword
lore: A rusty, beat up and jagged old sword. This old sword has been used for many years and then left by the road to rust.

name: Sharp Sword
lore: It's lightweight, sharp and sits well in any hand. The pommel and hilt is well balanced against the blade. A sword for fighting, not for showing off.

name: Simple Axe
lore: The curved blade makes it slightly more effecient when cutting a limb of a man, as opposed to a branch of a tree.

name: Mace
lore: Aim for the head, that's all there is to it. A blunt weapon that delivers powerful blows.

name: Morning Star
lore: As the sun sets the stars arise. When this star rises you'd best beware.

name: War Hammer
lore: One side to crush and one side to pierce. Both sides equally lethal to your opponent, armored or not.

name: The Oathkeeper
lore: "We march on no matter what. There will be no complaints, Im sure of it." ~ Captain Gilbert of Loth

name: Lightbringer
lore: "Close your eyes when you draw the sword, for the light will blind anyone who look directly into it." ~ Armormaster Hoek of the Royal Aurelian armory

name: Elemental Axe
lore: Is that.. fire, living inside of it?

name: Swamp Spear
lore: "Seek out the lair of the swamp crab and return with one of its claws as the new point of your spear. Such is the ritual of adulthood in our tribe. If you do not return well know your fate." ~ Chorak Ktar, Shaman of the Blue vine clan

name: Crossbow
lore: "Gunpowder and bullets? Pah! Baryan rubbish! When the rain pours down or when you need a silent shot, youll have to go with an Arleon crossbow." ~ Barnie "Barndoor" Twistroad, Arleon Sapper.

name: Boar Spear
lore: "For boar hunting and to fend off the Horned ones, right? Beasts of the forest needs to be treated in a seemly manner." ~ William Tightstring, Huntmaster of the Pinecoast Barony

name: Greatsword
lore: "The greatsword is feared by many, but most by the pikeneers, for it cuts through their pikes and ranks alike."  ~ Quoted from On the Art of Warfare by Ichtizar the Mercenary.

name: Great Axe
lore: This axe helped Growl Shieldbreaker to hold the bridge at the battle of Greatford. Few have the strength to wield it, no one has the stamina to endure a blow from it.

name: The Emancipator
lore: Once carried by one of the most famed Harima warriors in the great Baryan freedom wars. This grand flail can wreak havoc in the hands of the right Wielder.

name: Pole Axe
lore: A sufficient weapon against opponents with armor and more than devastating against enemies without it.

name: The Stinger
lore: The partisan is mainly used as a ceremonial weapon, bestowed by Baryan Merchants to the most vehement mercenaries. It is still an effective polearm but it's main purpose is to distinguish those who lead from those who follow.

name: Beak of the Beast
lore: It hungers for flesh and destruction. It feeds on death. This weapon is not a blessing, it's a curse.

name: Faey Horn War Bow
lore: "Cerkaleth Lighthorn gave her life so you could wield this bow. Do her death justice."

name: Staff of the Magus
lore: Once said to have been carried by the High Magus herself. Radiating with energy, this staff amplifies the power of essence in the most destructible manner.

name: Rod of the Roots
bonus: +5 Initiative | +20% Spell Damage Power | +20% Spell Damage Resistance
lore: "Feel the sap slowly travel through the staff. Recognize its essence. Let it invigorate yourself and your troops. This is a gift from the Roots. It will make you grow stronger." ~ Wildfir the Moss Clad
effect: +5 Initiative, +20% Spell Damage Power, +20% Spell Damage Resistance

name: Cracked Wooden Shield
lore: It can still protect you.

name: Roundshield
lore: Protection against arrows and melee weapons. The roundshield is favoured by many warriors.

name: Buckler Shield
lore: "Arleon steel goes a long way when it comes to protection against the evils of this world" ~ Baron William of Blackstone

name: Kite Shield
lore: Originally intended for cavalry, this type of shield has also gained popularity with footsoldiers. What the nobility wear to war will ever so often be mimicked by the common folk, if they can afford it.

name: Heavy Iron Shield
lore: "Squire, carry my shield will you?"

name: Heater Shield
lore: Steel, leather and rivets combined to perfection. The cuts and blows will deflect with ease for any wearer strong enough to carry this shield.

name: Ethylle's Blessing
lore: A mighty shield forged by the Faey, given to the son of Aurelia as a gift from the forest folk.

name: Spiked Shield
lore: What's not to understand? Take cover behind it or simply slam it into the face of your opponent. Both work.

name: Ethereal Shield
lore: It provides shelter from a storm of blades. Protection from a tempest of spells. This shield will counter steel with steel and essence with essence.

name: Shield of the Ogre
lore: "The ogres are few and far between. Peaceful by nature but when enraged they make even the Horned Ones look like gentle lambs. They keep their weapons and armor locked away and pray that it stays that way." ~ On the Folk of the Forest and How to Manage Them.

name: Shield of Eternal Servitude
bonus: +10 Defence | +1 Destruction Essence | +10% Spell Damage Power
lore: "Forge a shield from the armor of my slain foes. Insert my skull into the shield and place this gem of destructive essence between my jaws. Then bring this shield to war and let my scream sound across the battlefield for all eternity." ~ Excerpt from the last will of Nethyr the Scourge of Loth.
effect: +10 Defence, +1 Destruction Essence, +10% Spell Damage Power

name: Archers Helmet
lore: A simple steel helm often used by the archers of Arleon.

name: Leather Cowl
lore: The perfect Cowl to hide the wearers identity and offers some protection.

name: Helmet of the Vanir
lore: A simple steel helm, typically worn by Vanir raiders.

name: Baryan Headdress
lore: Lightweight and offering protection from the sun, this stylish headdress lends a certain swagger to any expedition.

name: Turban Helmet
lore: This helmet is popular only in the southernmost parts of Barya. Traditionally worn by the garrison troops of Forgewell and Dungtown, they often compete in how garish and spectacular the coloured cloth they can wrap around the metal dome.

name: Open Faced Bacinet
lore: A steel helmet no longer favored by the knights of Arleon, who prefer to obscure their faces in battle. But military surplus never goes to waste in a world torn apart by endless wars.

name: Sage's Mask
lore: Worn by the Rana Sages, this terrifying mask makes the enemy tremble with fear.

name: Helmet of the Arena
lore: In the dunes of Barya slave warriors are pitted against each other in great arenas. This helmet was once worn by the famed champion of Lastwell.

name: Visored Barbute
lore: For tournaments and warfare alike. The visored barbuta gives supreme protection where it matters most.

name: Golden Laurel Wreath
lore: Given to the most succesful mercenary captains of Barya upon their return from a victorious campaign. A testament of triumph and commendable leadership.

name: Mask of Wiesh
lore: The famed wielder, Wiesh, wore this amber infused mask to his deathbed.

name: Celestial Helmet
lore: Crafted from Celestial Ore it seems to highten the wearers senses and premonitions. A wielder clad in this helmet will lead his troops swiftly and defensively on the battlefield.

name: Dragonscale Crown
lore: "Surely it cant be real dragonscales? Ill proudly follow anyone who wears that crown and fight for whats just and good, no matter what."

name: Hat of the Magus
lore: Passed from masters to pupils in the mystical Coven of the Magus. Created hundreds of years ago with a technique now lost to time, the hats of the Magus are few and far between. No Wielder would separate from theirs while still drawing breath.

name: Archers Gambeson
lore: Cheap and easy to produce, it offers basic protection for troops of low rank.

name: Worn Brigandine
lore: A simple leather brigandine that has seen better days.

name: Leather Jacket
lore: A supple jacket suited for dark alleys where the work is quick and quiet.

name: Chainmail Hauberk
lore: The raiders of Vanir often stride the shores of faraway countries wearing these chainmails as their main protection.

name: Ornate Breastplate
lore: To protect the torso from blows, projectiles and magic. This chestplate is both durable and finely decorated.

name: Cuirass of the Sun
lore: Said to be crafted during the days of Aurelia herself. This ornamental armor is polished beyond belief, making it glow in direct sunlight.

name: Celestial Breastplate
lore: Crafted for a distinguished knight from the mineral of a meteorite. The magic properties of the metal grants the wearer superb protection.

name: The Cape of Leaves
lore: The Roots entrusted this cape to the Rana Protector of Gloomgrove before the battle of Fire Pass. It makes anyone hard to spot in open ground and near invisible in the forest.

name: Cowl of Endless Essence
bonus: +1 Order Essence | +1 Chaos Essence | +1 Creation Essence | +1 Destruction Essence | +1 Arcane Essence
lore: Sewn decades ago by the late Amaranthae Ermenor of the forest court. Infused with essence and pure magic woven into its fabric.
effect: +1 Order Essence, +1 Creation Essence, +1 Chaos Essence, +1 Arcana Essence, +1 Destruction Essence

name: Cloak of the Ancients
bonus: +5 Defence | +30% Spell Damage Resistance | +2 View Radius
lore: Take this to cloak yourself from the magic of thy enemy. Let this cloth be worn to combat time itself, but let it never fall into the hands of another Wielder.
effect: +5 Defence, +30% Spell Damage Resistance, +2 View Radius

name: Tunic of the Forest Court
lore: The folk of the forest don't wear this type of garb themselves, but on rare occasions they bestow a finely woven tunic to someone who shares their love of the wildwood.

name: Worn Gloves
lore: For chopping wood, lifting hot cauldrons and the occasional brawl.

name: Vanir Bracers
lore: These leather bracers, made by Vanir artisans speak of the creativity and skill of the Bleak East Craftsmen.

name: Wrapped Bracers
lore: Strong Leather wrappings made from the skin of the Ravager protect the hands of the wearer, the added studs puts extra strength in their blows

name: Gloves of the Wild Hunt
lore: "These gloves are not for the common man, neither are they for anyone who disturbs the Faey of the forest. To buy my craft you need to be worthy of it." ~ Henry Dunfort, Master leather worker

name: Gauntlets
lore: Worn by Knights and Fists of Order alike, these gauntlets protects the wearer during hand to hand combat.

name: Celestial Gauntlets
lore: Celestial ore has many uses, but most smiths agree that it serves best as material for armor. These gauntlets are a true testament to the wonders of this heavenly mineral.

name: Glimmergloves
lore: "Object: Richly decorated gloves. Place of origin: Aurelian crypt near the digsite. Magical properties: They seem to weaken any spells directed towards the wearer." ~ Note regarding artifact no 35, Loth excavation no 14

name: Gloves of the Merchants Guild
lore: Traditionally awarded to merchants when accepted into the most distinguished guild of Barya. Worn for weddings, funerals and signing contracts.

name: Gauntlets of the Night
lore: "Gauntlets, black as midnight, shall guard you night and day. They give you strength to crush your foes and many you shall slay." ~ Nornor verse

name: Gauntlets of Essence
lore: Feel the essence within you and let it flow freely. These gauntlets will unleash your true power as a Wielder. They amplify the strength of your spells and will leave your opponents trembling in fear.

name: Gauntlets of the Night
lore: "Gauntlets, black as midnight, shall guard you night and day. They give you strength to crush your foes and many you shall slay." ~ Nornor verse

name: Gloves of Eternity
lore: The gloves shimmer with power and seem to slow down time itself. The wielder wearing them can command his army to act twice as fast, but it also takes a toll on the troops, making them weaker in the process.
effect: +1 Attacks, -50 Melee Offence, -50 Ranged Offence, -50 Troop Defence

name: Gloves of the Phoenix
lore: "The Phoenix is not a legend, Ive called it to soar the skies and wreak havoc on my enemies. These gloves will aid you in calling it, but it will drain your weakest troops to the point of death. Everything comes at a cost, right?" ~ Grand Magus Allirahann from the Rowaindale guild of Wielders
effect: +3 Destruction Essence, +3 Creation Essence, -3 Health, -20 Troop Defence

name: Worn Boots
lore: Sturdy and well worn, they've seen better days, but still work as intended.

name: Thigh Boots
lore: These stylish boots are warm and attract attention wherever they go. Sometimes style pays off.

name: Riding Boots
lore: These well made boots make life on and off the roads slightly more pleasurable.

name: Shoes of the Wanderer
lore: When the road ahead is long and the terrain is rough, the Shoes of the Wanderer takes you longer distances in a shorter period of time.

name: Simple Sandals
lore: The perfect sandals for an easier march through swamps and marshes.

name: Sassanid Velvet Shoes
lore: The sassanids of Barya see no shame in dealing death in the darkness of night. These finely crafted shoes allow the wearer to travel more swiftly and silently, regardless of the time of the day.

name: Masterly Crafted Boots
lore: "Wear them at court, wear them when travelling. Youll look good and reach further, as easy as that mlord!" ~ Henry Dunfort, Master leather worker

name: Spiked Boots
lore: Theyre not the most fashionable or even comfortable footwear. But when it comes to traversing rough terrain or kicking your enemy in the groin they do their job with honors.

name: Boots of the Whispering Leaves
lore: A gift from Cithrell Ethalia of the Gloomwood, to her son Lyfis Hather before his ill-fated journey to the Tenderwyld.

name: Nimble Boots
lore: Said to be crafted by the skin of ancient Durathror. Gigantic elks rumoured to have been roaming the deepest parts of Gloomwood forest on the continent of Patriam.

name: Boots of the Heavens
lore: "We shall run like the wind and strike like thunder."

name: Tools of the Master Mason
lore: A talented stone mason can achieve wonders using these tools.

name: Enchanted Bag of Acorns
lore: Each acorn grows into a full grown oak in just a few days. Every morning the bag is filled anew.

name: The Golden Goose
lore: "I dont care what you feed it as long as it keeps laying those golden eggs."

name: Everflowing Branch of Sap
lore: This ancient branch is said to stem from one of the original tree mothers. Each morning it weeps, longing for its mother, producing tears of sap that quickly hardens into ancient amber.

name: Glimmerweave Spinning Wheel
lore: Once set in motion, it never seems to stop. As the wheel keeps spinning, the thread of Glimmerweave gets longer and longer.

name: Celestial Compass
lore: This device was contrived by one of the most distinguished tinkerers of Barya. It helps a prospector find the impact sites of celestial ore fallen from the skies.

name: Never Ending Chest of Gold
lore: The Baryan artificer that created this marvel was rewarded with death for his ingenuity. Gold is valuable because of its scarcity. The chest was stowed away for centuries, but secrets have a way of escaping even the securest of dungeons.

name: Baryan Glasses
lore: The wonders of the Baryan tinkersmiths knows no end. The glass lenses are set in a frame of celestial ore, perhaps that is why you can spot things that are so far away?

name: All Seeing Eye
lore: Forged from an alloy of Celestial Ore and silver with Ancient Amber inlays. This talisman grants the wearer a better vision of objects far away.

name: The Makers Compass
lore: It will lead you to adventures beyond your imagination. Always finding the shortest route to whatever your destination is. An amazing contraption said to be made by the finest Baryan tinkersmith ever to have lived.

name: Mechanical Bird
lore: Turn the key, get lulled to sleep by the gentle clicking of the cogs and wake up to its mechanical song. The age of the rooster is over.

name: Braid of the Horned Ones
lore: When chieftains die they leave their braids to their eldest offspring. Tradition says it infuses them with rage and strength of the foes once slain by the one who wore the braid.

name: The Lute of Pinecoast
lore: "I find that nothing motivates the troop like a good minstrel and a lute."

name: The Bones of Cornelius
bonus: +40% Spell Damage Power | +20% Spell Damage Resistance
lore: The son of Aurelia is said to have been a powerful Wielder. This relic, still harboring the strength of his essence, proves it.
effect: +40% Spell Damage Power, +20% Spell Damage Resistance

name: Ancient Amber Spyglass
lore: Crafted by the most prestigious Baryan tinkersmiths. The lense of Ancient Amber gives a superior overview of the surroundings and helps ranged troops to better find their targets.

name: Arcane Tome
lore: "Only those who Wield the Essence can truly understand the contents of this book. It is intended for those who are touched by magic and not the common folk." ~ Foreword by the author, Arch Magus Fawn Serphent

name: Drum of the Marches
lore: The drum beats like the heart of the Marsh and lends ease and speed through the treacherous waters that hamper our enemies. The Marsh provides.

name: Vial of the Heart
lore: "Take a sip, just a small one. It will invigorate you through the storm of war." ~ Ulann Dor of the Origin River clan

name: Banner of Unyielding Hatred
lore: Said to have been carried to war by Aurelia herself as she first set foot on the shores of Patriam. Where this banner goes, troops will follow without a doubt.

name: Petrified Dragon Egg
lore: Seeping with essence and power beyond mere mortals. Anyone carrying this ancient egg will see their troops grow stronger and more healthy.

name: Skull of Aeons
lore: This relic was handed down from Wielder to Wielder through generations. Use it with utmost care and caution. Your troops will gain strength beyond belief but also be too fatigued to defend themselves.

name: Pipes of Glory
lore: Said to have been played by Carmen di Husni, of the SkyShield Battalion, at the reckoning of Ham el Lien. This legendary pipe infuses your troops with vigour and swiftness.

name: Aurelia's Ashes
lore: "Show the urn to the troops and they will follow you across the world and back. Her power is still great, even in death."

name: Endless Samovar
lore: This remarkable samovar made of ancient amber and celestial ore is said to hail from somewhere along the cold coasts of Vanir. It refills itself with hot tea that invigorates and strengthens anyone drinking it.

name: Talisman of Order
lore: Made a long time ago but still looks as new. The Essence of Order remains strong within it. This is one of the fabled five Talismans of Essence.

name: Talisman of Chaos
lore: Before time there was Chaos and the essence of Chaos flows through this ancient talisman, thought to be one of the fabled five Talismans of Essence.

name: Talisman of Creation
lore: Contrived in a time long before this. Essence of Creation grows from it. This is one of the fabled five Talismans of Essence.

name: Talisman of Destruction
lore: Older than the age of men. The essence of Destruction lives within it. This is one of the fabled five Talismans of Essence.

name: Talisman of Arcana
lore: Forged with magic from the beginning of time and imbued with the essence of Arcana, this is one of the fabled five Talismans of Essence.

name: Town Portal Scroll
lore: Creates a temporary portal that leads to your own town or settlement of choice. The scroll will be destroyed.

name: Woodcutters Axe
lore: Cuts wood and cleaves flesh.

name: Ancient Key
lore: An old iron key that seems to be fitting a large lock. Where could that be?

name: Cowl of the Spectres
lore: The rare Cowl shimmered with a faint glow as if the ichor from the Hearts moved through each weft and weave.

name: Gloves of the Bones
lore: These ancient gloves, enhanced by the femur of the mighty Grym, imbue strength to the Bones of the fallen faithful.

name: Knell of Binding
lore: The bell on this staff has been infused with the binding power that the Roots hold and hums of its own accord. It's never silent.

name: Dodecahedron Eternal
lore: "What has been done is remarkable, strengthening the Oath, and now the Faithful will truly serve forever. The next step is to find a way to do this without the Dodecahedron." -Kastus Maal

name: Mantle of the Oathbound
lore: Infusing the mantle with the Dread's power was not an easy task, but no one can argue with the result.

name: Mirror of the Moon
lore: "May this mirror gift you many a pleasant sight." -Coral Lightbringer

name: Blade of Dread
lore: "It was one of the greatest deeds. Figil ventured into the Wyldwoods and came back with the blade of a Dread. With it he slayed many foes." ~ The Book of Deeds

name: Blade of Terror
lore: "Figils son, Eskbjorn, used his fathers blade to slay a Terror. From its terrible arms he forged his own blade. He was a man to be feared by all." ~ Old man Fiskeknut

name: Bone Crown
lore: "...and from the bones of these beasts she forged a crown of great power. She wore it until her final days." ~ The deeds of Glitterhorn

name: Bear Ribcage
lore: The bear is a powerful creature, and some of its vitality has been fused to remain within this ribcage.

name: Staff Of Binding
bonus: +10% Spell Damage Power, +10 Necromancy Generation Broken Vessel, +20% Spell Damage Resistance
lore: This staff was made from a living Tree Mother, binding its power of resurrection within it. Any who wields it also wield the power of the Roots.
effect: +10% Spell Damage Power, +10 Necromancy Generation Broken Vessel, +20% Spell Damage Resistance

name: Snail Shell Helmet
lore: This shell is harder than it looks. It comes with a tingling sensation of Creation Essence.

name: Carapace Armor
lore: Interlocking plates protect their wearer from harm while also maintaining easy movement.

name: Mushroom Cloak
bonus: +10% Melee Resistance, +10% Ranged Resistance, +10% Spell Damage Resistance
lore: Doesn't look like much, but it grows on you.
effect: +10% Melee Resistance, +10% Ranged Resistance, +10% Spell Damage Resistance

name: Fruit of the Wyldwoods
lore: "This fruit is so sweet and delicious, Ill talk to anyone who can offer it to me." ~ Orkar Ås, Bandit Chieftain

name: Whip of Lashing
lore: A powerful whip, made from the vines of a Lasher.

name: Thorn Whip
lore: This whip leaves a mark. Many marks.

name: Bronze Decapoda
lore: "Ive never liked crabs, but this figurine is fine work." ~ PCha

name: Riders Helm
lore: The fearsome Riders know well how important a good helmet is.

name: Guandao
lore: Equally strong on the offence as the defence.

name: Lamellar Armor
lore: This stiff armor stiffens the spine of anyone who wears it.

name: Bronze Bell
lore: Some amount of any hostile magic may be absorbed by the bell. Some people may want more precise amounts than "some" and "may".

name: Feather Fan
lore: These fans are often used by the Yulan strategists.

name: Hailstorm
lore: The legendary bow Hailstorm will rain down arrows on the battlefield.

name: Ji
lore: "Reach your enemy before they reach you." ~ Li Wei, renowned strategist.

name: Dadao
lore: With an edge honed to perfection, this flexible blade has felled many foes.

name: Silken Robe
bonus: +10% Spell Damage Resistance, +20% Spell Damage Power
lore: This traditional robe of office marks the wearer as someone deserving of respect.
effect: +10% Spell Damage Resistance, +20% Spell Damage Power

name: Mian
lore: A elaborate expression of power and office.

name: Tian Necklace
lore: Within the necklace battles the forces of Chaos and Order

name: Gourd Flask
lore: "Fill it, empty it, repeat. Life is good." ~ Sheng Shun
